title: crypto2dev_rng.c: register DRBG as kernel crypto_rng
description: Register wolfCrypt's DRBG as a kernel crypto_rng algorithm with .cra_name='stdrng' (the name kernel consumers use for the default RNG). Implement: .generate calls wolfkm_fips_gate() then wc_RNG_GenerateBlock(); .seed reseeds via get_random_bytes() passed to wc_RNG_DRBG_Reseed() or equivalent wolfCrypt reseed API. wolfcrypt.ko initializes the DRBG at load time — wolfkm_rng.c wraps the existing instance, it does NOT create a new one.
design: wolfCrypt's DRBG entropy source (get_random_bytes()) is the subject of HUMAN_TASK_007 — the FIPS argument for this must come from the FIPS consultant, not from this code. The implementation just wraps the existing wolfCrypt RNG. .cra_flags must include CRYPTO_ALG_TYPE_RNG. See DESIGN.md §rng.
acceptance_criteria: Generates 10,000 bytes without error. Generated bytes pass basic chi-squared bias check. Algorithm appears in /proc/crypto with wolfkm driver.
close_reason: Stale: from abandoned kernel-crypto-API-registration design. crypto2dev does not register into kernel crypto API (wolfcrypt.ko does that). Current implementation uses chardev+provider model instead.
